metadata.name: bordrless_token
metadata.description: The Bordrless Token Standard (BTS): mints, holdings, transfers, delegation, freezing, on-chain metadata, and the hook protocol that lets a program run before and after every transfer, mint and burn, take up to three cuts from a transfer and keep 64 bytes of state in every holding.

docs: Instructions of the token standard.

instructions.name: approve
docs: Lets `delegate` move up to `amount` from the holding.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner.

instructions.name: burn
docs: Burns `amount` from a holding; its owner or delegate signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The source's owner or delegate.

accounts.name: hook_signer
docs: `["hook-authority", hook_program]` (checked in the handler); unused (this program's id)
otherwise.

instructions.name: close_holding
docs: Closes an empty holding and returns its rent; the owner signs. Refused while the mint's
hook writes hook data and the holding still has some.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The holding's mint (its hook decides whether hook data blocks the close).

instructions.name: create_holding
docs: Creates the holding of `owner` for `mint`, or does nothing if it exists.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

instructions.name: create_mint
docs: Creates a mint. The mint account signs (a keypair, or a PDA of the creating program).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new mint, which signs.

instructions.name: create_slot_mint
docs: Hookwars: creates a mint with a slot table and no single hook.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new mint, which signs.

instructions.name: mint_to
docs: Mints `amount` into a holding; the mint authority signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The mint authority.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Receives the tokens.

accounts.name: hook_signer
docs: `["hook-authority", hook_program]` (checked in the handler); unused (this program's id)
otherwise.

instructions.name: revoke
docs: Removes the holding's delegate.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Replaces or revokes one of the mint's authorities; the current one signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The current authority of the kind being set.

instructions.name: set_frozen
docs: Freezes or thaws a holding; the freeze authority signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The freeze authority.

instructions.name: set_hook
docs: Sets or clears the mint's hook; the hook authority signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The hook authority.

instructions.name: set_slot_item
docs: Hookwars: the armory puts an item in a slot (or empties it).

accounts.name: slot_authority
docs: The armory's `["slots", mint]` PDA, signing by CPI.

instructions.name: set_vote_lock
docs: Hookwars: the armory locks a holding's tokens in place for a vote.

accounts.name: slot_authority
docs: The armory's `["slots", mint]` PDA, signing by CPI.

instructions.name: touch
docs: Hookwars: one slot's item may rewrite one holding's range.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Any signer; the item decides whether to act for it.

instructions.name: transfer
docs: Moves `amount` from one holding to another, running the mint's hooks. The authority is the
source's owner or its delegate.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The source's owner or delegate.

accounts.name: hook_signer
docs: `["hook-authority", hook_program]` (checked in the handler); unused (this program's id)
otherwise.

instructions.name: transfer_from_protocol
docs: Hookwars (R16): a transfer out of a protocol vault; on a slot mint only the Locked slot runs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The source's owner or delegate.

accounts.name: hook_signer
docs: `["hook-authority", hook_program]` (checked in the handler); unused (this program's id)
otherwise.

instructions.name: update_metadata
docs: Updates the mint's metadata; the metadata authority signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The metadata authority.

instructions.name: write_hook_data
docs: The mint's hook program replaces a holding's hook data, signing with its
`["hook-authority"]` PDA; the mint must have `WRITES_HOOK_DATA`.

accounts.name: hook_signer
docs: The `["hook-authority"]` PDA (canonical bump) of the mint's hook program, signing by CPI.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: the amount is zero

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: insufficient funds

errors.name: InsufficientDelegation
errors.msg: insufficient delegated amount

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.msg: the authority is neither the owner nor the delegate

errors.name: Frozen
errors.msg: the holding is frozen

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: the holding belongs to another mint

errors.name: SameAccount
errors.msg: source and destination are the same holding

errors.name: AuthorityRevoked
errors.msg: the mint has no such authority or it was revoked

errors.name: HookProgramMissing
errors.msg: the mint has a hook program but it was not passed

errors.name: WrongHookProgram
errors.msg: the hook program passed is not the mint's

errors.name: DeltaTooLarge
errors.msg: the hook returned a delta larger than the amount

errors.name: InvalidDeltaAccount
errors.msg: the hook named an invalid delta account

errors.name: MaxSupplyExceeded
errors.msg: the max supply would be exceeded

errors.name: InvalidHookFlags
errors.msg: invalid hook flags

errors.name: InvalidMetadata
errors.msg: invalid metadata

errors.name: InvalidDecimals
errors.msg: invalid decimals

errors.name: HoldingNotEmpty
errors.msg: the holding is not empty

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: math overflow

errors.name: HoldingMismatch
errors.msg: the holding exists for another mint or owner

errors.name: BadHookSigner
errors.msg: the hook signer is not this program's signer for the mint's hook program

errors.name: UnsupportedHookReturn
errors.msg: the hook answered something this callback or the mint's flags do not allow

errors.name: InvalidHookReturn
errors.msg: the hook's answer does not decode

errors.name: TooManyDeltas
errors.msg: the hook answered more than three deltas

errors.name: ZeroDelta
errors.msg: the hook answered a delta of zero

errors.name: HookDataNotEmpty
errors.msg: the holding still keeps hook data for its mint's hook

errors.name: HookDataNotWritable
errors.msg: the mint has no hook that writes hook data

errors.name: NotHookAuthority
errors.msg: the signer is not the hook authority of the mint's hook program

errors.name: InvalidSlotTable
errors.msg: the slot table breaks a rule of slot tables

errors.name: InvalidSlotAuthority
errors.msg: the slot authority is not the armory's [\slots\, mint] PDA

errors.name: MixedHookModes
errors.msg: a mint has either one hook or a slot table, never both

errors.name: TooManyCuttingSlots
errors.msg: too many slots may cut on one transfer

errors.name: SlotIndexOutOfRange
errors.msg: no such slot

errors.name: SlotLocked
errors.msg: the slot is locked

errors.name: SlotEmpty
errors.msg: the slot is empty

errors.name: InvalidSlotItem
errors.msg: the slot item is not acceptable

errors.name: SlotFlagsNotAllowed
errors.msg: the slot's kind or bounds do not allow these flags

errors.name: WrongEquipVault
errors.msg: a slot's cut must go to its equip vault

errors.name: SlotCutExceeded
errors.msg: the cut exceeds the slot's bound

errors.name: SlotDataLength
errors.msg: a slot's data answer has the wrong length

errors.name: SlotAccountsMismatch
errors.msg: the slot accounts do not match the slots called

errors.name: TouchNotSupported
errors.msg: the slot does not answer touch

errors.name: PayloadTooLong
errors.msg: the payload is too long

errors.name: VoteLocked
errors.msg: the holding's tokens are locked for a vote

errors.name: VoteLockExceedsBalance
errors.msg: the vote lock exceeds the balance

errors.name: NotProtocolSource
errors.msg: the source is not a protocol vault

types.name: AuthorityKind
docs: Which authority `set_authority` replaces.

types.name: CreateMintArgs
docs: Arguments of `create_mint`.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals (at most 12).

fields.name: name
docs: Name (at most 32 bytes).

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol (at most 10 bytes).

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI (at most 200 bytes).

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Largest supply allowed; 0 for unlimited.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: May mint.

fields.name: freeze_authority
docs: May freeze.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: The hook program.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Its flags (zero without a hook program).

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: May change the hook later.

fields.name: metadata_authority
docs: May change the metadata later.

types.name: DeltaApplied
docs: One delta a `before_transfer` answer took: the holding it credited, that holding's owner, the
amount and the holding's balance after.

types.name: Holding
docs: A holding: the token account of `owner` for `mint`, at `["holding", mint, owner]`.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of the PDA.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint.

fields.name: owner
docs: The owner.

fields.name: amount
docs: Balance.

fields.name: delegate
docs: Delegate, if any.

fields.name: delegated_amount
docs: What the delegate may still move.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Frozen holdings cannot send, receive or burn.

fields.name: hook_data
docs: State the mint's hook keeps for this holder (`bordrless_hook::HOOK_DATA_LEN` bytes). Only
the mint's hook program changes it: by answering a `before_*` callback, or through
`write_hook_data`, and only while the mint has `WRITES_HOOK_DATA`. Zero until then.

fields.name: vote_locked
docs: Hookwars (R11): tokens the armory locked for a vote (was `reserved[0..8]`).

fields.name: vote_lock_until
docs: Hookwars (R11): unix time the lock ends; 0 with no lock (was `reserved[8..16]`).

types.name: HookDataWritten
docs: The mint's hook program wrote a holding's hook data through `write_hook_data`.

types.name: Mint
docs: A mint. Address: any signer at creation (a keypair, or a PDA of the creating program).

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Decimals.

fields.name: supply
docs: Current supply.

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Largest supply ever allowed; 0 means unlimited.

fields.name: mint_authority
docs: May mint; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: freeze_authority
docs: May freeze and thaw holdings; `None` once revoked.

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: May change the hook; `None` locks the hook for ever.

fields.name: metadata_authority
docs: May change the metadata; `None` fixes it for ever.

fields.name: hook_program
docs: The hook program, if any.

fields.name: hook_flags
docs: Which callbacks run (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`).

fields.name: name
docs: Name.

fields.name: symbol
docs: Symbol.

fields.name: uri
docs: Metadata URI.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who paid for the creation.

fields.name: hook_signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", hook_program]`, this program's signer of every callback to the
hook (one per hook program, so a hook can tell its own callbacks from a signer another hook
passed on); 0 without a hook. Set with the hook.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

fields.name: slot_authority
docs: Hookwars: the armory's `["slots", mint]` PDA, which alone may change the slots and vote
locks; `None` when the table never changes.

fields.name: slot_count
docs: Hookwars: entries of `slots` in use (0: no slot table, the upstream single hook applies).

fields.name: slots
docs: Hookwars: the slot table, in call order; entries at `slot_count..` are zero.

types.name: Slot
docs: One slot of a mint (docs/spec/01-token-slots.md section 1.1).

fields.name: kind
docs: `bordrless_hook::slot_kind`.

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: `bordrless_hook::equip_rule` (stored, never acted on here).

fields.name: bounds
docs: Fixed bounds.

fields.name: data_offset
docs: First byte of this slot's range in `Holding.hook_data`.

fields.name: data_len
docs: Length of the range (item slots: including the epoch byte; 0 without data).

fields.name: item
docs: The equipped item (default when empty or Locked).

fields.name: program
docs: The program that runs (default when empty).

fields.name: flags
docs: Token callbacks and answers (`bordrless_hook::slot_flags`).

fields.name: pool_flags
docs: Pool slots only: the launchpad's pool flags (stored, never read here).

fields.name: equip_vault
docs: The only holding a cut of this slot may credit (default when the slot never cuts).

fields.name: signer_bump
docs: Bump of `["hook-authority", program]` under this program.

fields.name: launch_signer_bump
docs: Pool slots only: bump of the launchpad's `["hook-authority", program]`.

fields.name: data_epoch
docs: Tags this slot's data in every holding; changes on every equip; starts at 1.

fields.name: extra_count
docs: Extra accounts the item takes after its program and signer (fixed when equipped; the
Locked slot's when created). Hookwars M1: replaces the `slot_accounts` argument (M1 notes).

types.name: SlotBounds
docs: Bounds a slot keeps for life.

fields.name: max_cut_bps
docs: Most an item in this slot may cut from one transfer, in bps of the amount.

fields.name: may_refuse
docs: Whether an item may refuse operations (declared; not enforceable at run time).

fields.name: may_write_data
docs: Whether an item may write this slot's hook-data range.

fields.name: may_answer_touch
docs: Whether an item may answer `touch`.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Hookwars R21: Pool slots only: whether an item may burn part of a swap (through the
launchpad's pool-slot forwarding, M3b).

types.name: SlotCut
docs: One slot's cut of a transfer.

fields.name: item
docs: The item (default for the Locked slot).

types.name: SlotEquipped
docs: A slot's item changed (an empty included).

types.name: SlotInfo
docs: What `SlotsInitialized` reports per slot.

fields.name: may_burn
docs: Hookwars R21.

fields.name: locked_program
docs: The Locked slot's program (default otherwise).

types.name: SlotInit
docs: One slot of a new slot table.

fields.name: kind
docs: `bordrless_hook::slot_kind`.

fields.name: equip_rule
docs: `bordrless_hook::equip_rule`.

fields.name: bounds
docs: Bounds for life.

fields.name: data_len
docs: Item slots: range length including the epoch byte, or 0. Locked: the legacy program's
range from byte 0 (the kit: 32), or 0.

fields.name: locked_program
docs: Locked slot only: the legacy program.

fields.name: locked_flags
docs: Locked slot only: its upstream token flags.

fields.name: locked_extra_count
docs: Locked slot only: how many extra accounts it takes (its registry's length).

types.name: SlotsInitialized
docs: A mint was created with a slot table (after `MintCreated`).

types.name: Transferred
docs: A transfer. The source lost `amount`; the destination gained `amount` less the deltas; each
delta holding gained its amount. Hook data is not in events.

fields.name: slot_cuts
docs: Hookwars: one entry per slot that cut (empty for a mint without slots).

types.name: VoteLockSet
docs: The armory set a holding's vote lock.
